[]{#sec-page42}

To complete this opening day of the course, take a few minutes to imagine yourself in each of the following
ten pairs of opposite environments. Then compare and write down some features describing how you
would behave and perform in those contrasting situations.

* Your work is (a) greatly fulfilling and exciting, or it’s (b) dull and demoralising.

```{ojs}
import { persist } from "../../../assets/scripts/workbook.js"

viewof activity_1f_1a = persist(
  "content/days/day-01/13-major-activity.qmd#activity_1f_1a",
  Inputs.textarea({
  label: "Your work is greatly fulfilling and exciting",
  placeholder: "(a)",
  rows: 5
})
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof activity_1f_1b = persist(
  "content/days/day-01/13-major-activity.qmd#activity_1f_1b",
  Inputs.textarea({
  label: "Your work is dull and demoralising",
  placeholder: "(b)",
  rows: 5
})
)
```
